outboundMessages.description: Sends an outbound message to Groove with the record ID and owner ID. This is used for real-time auto-import to Groove Flow.
outboundMessages.name: Notify Groove (Managed)

rules.description: This WF rule can be activated if you want to notify Groove that a new contact was created. That way Groove can e.g. instantly import the contact to a Groove Flow that has auto import enabled (and meets the auto-import rules of that Flow).
